# GTM Growth

> Open-source MCP server for GA4, Google Tag Manager, Search Console and AI-search readiness — free read with SEO, GA4 and Search Console tables, full GEO audit, GTM measurement plan.

## Product

- [Landing page](https://gtm.kayroslab.com/): free read — URL hygiene score, then SEO tables plus GA4 and Search Console reports; full audit and assisted GTM engagement after that
- [Version française](https://gtm.kayroslab.com/fr/): lecture gratuite de l’URL, puis audit complet et accompagnement GTM
- [Sample report](https://gtm.kayroslab.com/reports/opendpe.html): full audit of opendpe.net, 71/100 with platform readiness and the fix plan
- [Sample report PDF](https://gtm.kayroslab.com/reports/opendpe.pdf): the same audit as a client-ready 9-page PDF, with the dashboard, radar and entity graph
- [Repository](https://github.com/Geoking2104/GTM-Growth): Apache-2.0, Node.js 20+
- [GEO rubric](https://github.com/Geoking2104/GTM-Growth/blob/main/docs/GEO.md): eight categories, 100 points, evidence per check
- [GTM implementation guide](https://github.com/Geoking2104/GTM-Growth/blob/main/docs/GTM_IMPLEMENTATION.md): snippets, dataLayer, consent, verification

- [CLI reference](https://github.com/Geoking2104/GTM-Growth/blob/main/docs/CLI.md)
- [IndexNow guide](https://github.com/Geoking2104/GTM-Growth/blob/main/docs/INDEXNOW.md): the push protocol Bing, Yandex, Seznam and Naver share
